query.description: What was looked up: name, id or address.

type.description: The type found; null when the name matched several candidates or none.

id.description: Stable id: pdb:0x1A2B (type record), pdb:Name (typedef), rtti:<type descriptor VA>, metadata:Ns.Type (#statics), ida:Name.

kind.description: struct, class, union, enum, typedef, pointer, array, function, bitfield, scalar, modifier, interface or statics.

source.description: pdb, rtti, pdb+rtti, metadata or the engine's id.

size.description: Size in bytes; -1 when the source does not record it (RTTI).

alignment.description: Alignment; for PDB types computed from the members (the PDB records none).

packed.description: A member is not at its natural alignment (#pragma pack).

forwardOnly.description: Only a forward declaration exists in the source.

referenced.description: Id of the pointee, array element, enum's underlying type or typedef's target.

fields.description: Fields in offset order, one page of them.

items.description: A field of a type, a base subobject, a vftable pointer, a static member or a padding gap.

offset.description: Offset in bytes from the start of the type; -1 for static members and virtual bases.

size.description: Size in bytes (a bit field's storage unit); -1 when unknown.

name.description: Name; nested rows (depth > 0) are dotted paths such as header.magic.

type.description: C spelling of the field's type.

typeId.description: Id of the field's type for get_native_type id=...; null for scalars.

kind.description: member, base, vbase, vfptr, static, padding or header (AOT object header).

bitOffset.description: First bit of a bit field in its storage unit.

bitSize.description: Width of a bit field in bits.

note.description: Source-specific detail: the managed type and declaring class for AOT metadata, computed offsets.

value.description: read=true: the field's value in the image's bytes.

enumerators.description: Enumerators sorted by value, one page of them.

hex.description: The value in hex (two's complement for negatives).

flagsLike.description: Every enumerator is a power of two or a combination of them.

this.description: The this pointer's type of a member function; null otherwise.

offset.description: Offset of the base subobject; -1 for a virtual base.

subobjectOffset.description: Offset of the subobject whose vftable pointer points here.

entries.description: One page of the slots (offset / limit).

offset.description: Byte offset of the slot in the vftable ([rax+40h] reads slot 8 on x64).

globalsOfType.description: Data symbols (PDB globals) of this type: count, and the first names.

declaration.description: C declaration (format=c, or the engine's own).

candidates.description: Types whose name contains the query (no exact match), one page of them.

owner.description: address=: the typed item containing it (PDB global, vftable, metadata slot).

paths.description: The field path(s) at the address or at=.

items.description: The field at an offset: one path per overlapping member (unions, bit fields sharing a unit).

path.description: C path from the type: players[3].pos.y.

offset.description: Offset of the field reached, from the start of the type the path starts at.

remainder.description: Bytes into that field (0 at its start).

offset.description: Index of the first returned field, enumerator, slot or candidate.

truncated.description: More rows exist past this page: call again with offset = offset + rows returned.

readAddress.description: read=true: where the values were read (VA).

value.description: read=true on a type without fields (scalar, enum, pointer, array): its value.
